---
title: "Shield of Undo"
---

::: {.quest-dialog}
**Prerequisites:** a terminal and `git`. **Objective:** make any change reversible before an agent touches it.

<span class="ao-badge">Verified: ran these commands with git 2.54.0 on 2026-11-13</span>
:::

Before any agent edits your files, put them under version control: `git init`, then `git add -A && git commit -m "before agent"`.
If the agent breaks something, `git restore .` returns every **tracked** file to that commit.

::: {.callout-warning}
Two things `git restore .` does *not* do for you. It also throws away **your own** uncommitted edits to tracked files, so commit before you start. And it leaves **new, untracked** files the agent created where they are; `git status` shows them and you delete them yourself.
:::

<div data-ao-test="crypt-shield-of-undo" data-xp="50"></div>
